description: Build, run and live-test FiveM servers with AI agents: RCON, DevCon, window control, mcpb bridge.
name: io.github.ziyacivan/fivem-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Machine running the FiveM client (DevCon host). Default 127.0.0.1
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Override the client devcon port (default: try 29200 then 29300)
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_CLIENT_DEVCON_PORT

environmentVariables.description: FXServer game host:port for RCON/getinfo. Default <FIVEM_HOST>:30120
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_RCON_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: Matches rcon_password in server.cfg; required for server_command and the bridge
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_RCON_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Path to FXServer's redirected stdout (server.log); enables server-side read_console/wait_for_console (optional fallback transport for pre-0.5 bridges)
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_SERVER_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Matches mcpb_token on the server when the bridge resource is configured with one
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_MCPB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Path to FiveM.exe for the launch tool. Default %LOCALAPPDATA%\FiveM\FiveM.exe
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_EXECUTABLE

environmentVariables.description: Client console lines kept in the ring buffer. Default 5000
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_CONSOLE_CAPACITY

environmentVariables.description: Consider client command output complete after this quiet period. Default 400
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_QUIET_MS

environmentVariables.description: Default max wait for client_command output. Default 5000
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to trace devcon frames and RCON round-trips on stderr
environmentVariables.name: FIVEM_MCP_DEBUG

title: FiveM MCP
